page_title: GRA 1-1 ALM | Granada CF v Almeria 18/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+9' Bruno Langa (Almeria) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
90+8' Today's referee Jesus Gil Manzano rightly decides to book Aleksandar Radovanovic (Almeria) for his harsh tackle.
90+4' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
90+1' Alexander Medina has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) replacing Facundo Pellistri.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' We are about to witness a subsitution. Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) for Faitout Maouassa.
90' The referee Jesus Gil Manzano awards Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) a yellow card.
89' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Luis Maximiano comes off the line to clear the ball away.
86' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Almeria, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
86' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) was too forceful with his tackle and Jesus Gil Manzano interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Almeria.
84' Gaizka Garitano has decided to substitute Iddrisu Baba and he is replaced by Dion Lopy (Almeria).
84' The Granada CF players can’t believe it after referee Jesus Gil Manzano signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
82' Celebrations by Granada CF are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
80' Marc Pubill (Almeria) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. A penalty is awarded to Granada CF!
79' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.

78' Kamil Piatkowski (Granada CF) outjumped the defenders to meet the ball from the free kick and plants a precise header from deep inside the box towards the net! The goalkeeper shows his reflexes and superbly keeps the ball out!
77' A yellow card for a tackle by Lucas Robertone (Almeria). Jesus Gil Manzano doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
75' 1 - 1 Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a precise shot inside the right post. What a lovely finish!
74' It will be a substitution. Marko Milovanovic (Almeria) is ready to enter the pitch as Choco Lozano walks off.
74' Granada CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
73' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. Granada CF force a corner. They send men into the box.
70' The attendance for today's match is 18756.
69' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Augusto Batalla to dive and make a save.
69' Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
68' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jesus Gil Manzano ignores the protests.

66' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
65' Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sergio Arribas.
65' The manager makes a subsitution with Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) coming on for Jonathan Viera.
65' Alexander Medina prepares a substitution. Martin Hongla is replaced by Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF).
65' The resulting corner from Sergio Arribas (Almeria) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
64' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Now Almeria have a corner.
62' Choco Lozano (Almeria) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
61' Almeria have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
60' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Adrian Embarba (Almeria). Jesus Gil Manzano saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Granada CF get a free kick.
58' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
58' A player from Granada CF commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
57' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Granada CF.

57' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Granada CF will take a corner.
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Granada CF comes to nothing.
53' Bruno Langa (Almeria) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
51' Bruno Langa (Almeria) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
51' Faitout Maouassa (Granada CF) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
50' The corner is flicked onto Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF), but his close-range header flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
49' Granada CF force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
49' A cross from Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Granada CF.
49' The corner is swung in but Granada CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

48' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Granada CF will have a chance to score from a corner.
48' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
47' The free kick is taken by Faitout Maouassa (Granada CF), but ball is cleared.
47' Jesus Gil Manzano interrupts the game. One of the players from Almeria won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick is awarded to Granada CF.
46' The resulting set piece from Almeria is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
46' Alexander Medina has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Lucas Boye (Granada CF) comes on the pitch for Oscar Melendo.
46' The whistle blows and Jesus Gil Manzano starts the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Rough tackle by Iddrisu Baba (Almeria). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Granada CF are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

45+1' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) makes a rough challenge and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Granada CF, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Almeria get a corner.
44' The free kick is delivered by Jonathan Viera (Almeria) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. Almeria have been awarded a corner kick.
43' Martin Hongla (Granada CF) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick to Almeria.
42' A cross from a corner kick by Granada CF is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
42' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Granada CF have been awarded a corner kick.
41' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Lucas Robertone (Almeria). It wasn't such a big threat for him.
39' A crossfield pass from Kamil Piatkowski (Granada CF) fails to find any of his teammates.
37' Kamil Piatkowski (Granada CF) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the top of the net, but Luis Maximiano makes a magnificent save!
36' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle. Marc Pubill (Almeria) commits a foul after dangerous play. Granada CF earn a free kick.
36' Granada CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

36' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Granada CF.

34' Faitout Maouassa (Granada CF) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
34' Bruno Langa (Almeria) probably handled the ball. That's a free kick to Granada CF.
33' The substitution is prepared. Faitout Maouassa (Granada CF) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gonzalo Villar.
32' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
32' Dangerous play by Marc Pubill (Almeria). Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul. Granada CF will take a free kick.
30' Jesus Gil Manzano blows for a foul after Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
30' Choco Lozano (Almeria) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
28' The resulting free kick from Sergio Arribas (Almeria) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
26' A corner kick by Granada CF is thwarted by the well prepared Luis Maximiano (Almeria).
26' Martin Hongla (Granada CF) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Granada CF.
25' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Almeria was in an offside position.
23' A goal, which was scored by Sergio Arribas (Almeria), was disallowed due to offside.
22' Jesus Gil Manzano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Adrian Embarba (Almeria). Granada CF will take a free kick near the side line.
21' Jonathan Viera (Almeria) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
19' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for an infringement.
19' Good movement by Adrian Embarba (Almeria), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
18' Almeria take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
17' Marc Pubill (Almeria) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Almeria are awarded a corner kick.
16' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) brings an opponent down and Jesus Gil Manzano interrupts the game. Almeria are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
14' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Almeria due to an offside in the build-up play.
14' Wait! Referee Jesus Gil Manzano immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
12' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Adrian Embarba (Almeria) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
12' Jonathan Viera (Almeria) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
12' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) commits a rough challenge and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for an infringement. Almeria have a free kick.

11' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Luis Maximiano has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
9' 0 - 1 Goal! The ball breaks to Marc Pubill (Almeria) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 0:1.
9' Marc Pubill (Almeria) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Augusto Batalla, who smothers the ball.
8' Kamil Piatkowski (Granada CF) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
8' Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) prepares to take a corner kick.

7' Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) gets inside the box and tries to beat Luis Maximiano with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. Granada CF will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
6' Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) is penalised for holding. Jesus Gil Manzano signals a set piece. Almeria have been awarded a free kick.
6' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
5' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
4' The foul by Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jesus Gil Manzano.

4' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul. Granada CF win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
2' Granada CF are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
1' Iddrisu Baba (Almeria) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! There is a free kick near the sideline to Granada CF.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
